rci1_using_msad.detail: Single site (UMCU) but 2 scanners used: Philips Intera and Philips Achieva 1.5T
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "Two scanners (same vendor, field strength and acquisition protocol) were used. Participants were scanned twice on either a Philips Intera or Achieva 1.5 T"

rci2_using_epd.detail: Reference data from in-house datasets: Utrecht Schizophrenia project and GROUP consortium (Utrecht site only)
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "Participants for the current study were selected from a large longitudinal sample based on two cohorts including patients with schizophrenia and healthy controls, the Utrecht Schizophrenia project and the Genetic Risk and Outcome of Psychosis (GROUP) consortium, in Utrecht, the Netherlands."

rci5_n.detail: Overall phase; all 164 healthy controls used as normative reference (no train/test split); 656 total scans from 164 HC and 164 patients across 2 time points
rci5_n.supporting_text: "The final data set consisted of 656 scans from 164 healthy participants and 164 patients."
rci5_n.location: Janssen2021.pdf.md: Methods / Sample and Neuroimaging, L35

rci6_sex.detail: Overall phase; male N reported directly; female N estimated from total N (164) minus male N (126) = 38
